messages.subject: Application Interest | Chief of Staff, Strategic Partnerships & Operations
messages.body:
Dear Starnest Talent Team,

I am writing regarding senior opportunities across Chief of Staff, strategic partnerships and operations. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy, corporate affairs, compliance, executive communications and cross-functional delivery.

My background combines multinational natural resources, banking and commercial operations, with extensive experience operating across senior institutional, regulatory and business interfaces. I am internationally mobile and open to global or remote leadership opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would welcome consideration for current or future roles aligned with my profile.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
